items.name: Ack & Brunt
items.description: Tyl Regor's custom axe and shield are how he likes to eliminate ‘frustrations'.

items.name: Amanata
items.description: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.

items.name: Amphis
items.description: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.

items.name: Anku
items.description: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.

items.name: Ankyros
items.description: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.

items.name: Ankyros Prime
items.description: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.

items.name: Arca Titron
items.description: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.

items.name: Argo & Vel
items.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

items.name: Arum Spinosa
items.description: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.

items.name: Atterax
items.description: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.

items.name: Azothane
items.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

items.name: Bo
items.description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.

items.name: Bo Prime
items.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.

items.name: Boltace
items.description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.

items.name: Broken Scepter
items.description: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.

items.name: Broken War
items.description: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.

items.name: Cadus
items.description: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.

items.name: Cassowar
items.description: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.

items.name: Caustacyst
items.description: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.

items.name: Ceramic Dagger
items.description: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.

items.name: Cerata
items.description: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.

items.name: Ceti Lacera
items.description: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.

items.name: Cobra & Crane
items.description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.

items.name: Cobra & Crane Prime
items.description: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.

items.name: Coda Caustacyst
items.description: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.

items.name: Coda Hirudo
items.description: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.

items.name: Coda Mire
items.description: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.

items.name: Coda Motovore
items.description: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.

items.name: Coda Pathocyst
items.description: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.

items.name: Corufell
items.description: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.

items.name: Corufell Prime
items.description: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.

items.name: Cronus
items.description: A strong blade forged using ceramic.

items.name: Dakra Prime
items.description: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.

items.name: Dark Dagger
items.description: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.

items.name: Dark Split-Sword
items.description: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.

items.name: Dark Sword
items.description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.

items.name: Destreza
items.description: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.

items.name: Destreza Prime
items.description: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.

items.name: Dex Dakra
items.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

items.name: Dex Nikana
items.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

items.name: Dorrclave
items.description: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.

items.name: Dragon Nikana
items.description: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.

items.name: Dual Cleavers
items.description: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.

items.name: Dual Ether
items.description: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.

items.name: Dual Heat Swords
items.description: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.

items.name: Dual Ichor
items.description: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.

items.name: Dual Kamas
items.description: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.

items.name: Dual Kamas Prime
items.description: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.

items.name: Dual Keres
items.description: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.

items.name: Dual Keres Prime
items.description: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.

items.name: Dual Raza
items.description: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.

items.name: Dual Skana
items.description: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.

items.name: Dual Viciss
items.description: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.

items.name: Dual Zoren
items.description: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

items.name: Dual Zoren Prime
items.description: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.

items.name: Edun
items.description: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

items.name: Ekhein
items.description: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.

items.name: Endura
items.description: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.

items.name: Ether Daggers
items.description: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.

items.name: Ether Reaper
items.description: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.

items.name: Ether Sword
items.description: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies.

items.name: Falcor
items.description: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.

items.name: Fang
items.description: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.

items.name: Fang Prime
items.description: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.

items.name: Fragor
items.description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

items.name: Fragor Prime
items.description: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.

items.name: Furax
items.description: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.

items.name: Furax Wraith
items.description: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.

items.name: Galariak Prime
items.description: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.

items.name: Galatine
items.description: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.

items.name: Galatine Prime
items.description: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.

items.name: Galvacord
items.description: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.

items.name: Gazal Machete
items.description: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.

items.name: Ghoulsaw
items.description: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.

items.name: Glaive
items.description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.

items.name: Glaive Prime
items.description: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.

items.name: Gram
items.description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.

items.name: Gram Prime
items.description: Born anew, the father of swords returns.

items.name: Guandao
items.description: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.

items.name: Guandao Prime
items.description: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.

items.name: Gunsen
items.description: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.

items.name: Gunsen Prime
items.description: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.

items.name: Halikar
items.description: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.

items.name: Halikar Wraith
items.description: A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.

items.name: Harmony
items.description:
Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

items.name: Hate
items.description: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.

items.name: Heat Dagger
items.description: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.

items.name: Heat Sword
items.description: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.

items.name: Heliocor
items.description: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

items.name: Hespar
items.description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.

items.name: Hirudo
items.description: Rip into the enemy with fists of razor sharp cartilage. Steals health with each critical hit.

items.name: Innodem
items.description: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.

items.name: Jat Kittag
items.description: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.

items.name: Jat Kusar
items.description: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.

items.name: Jaw Sword
items.description: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.

items.name: Kama
items.description: The Kama is a Tenno style hatchet, capable of making short work of any foe.

items.name: Karyst
items.description: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.

items.name: Karyst Prime
items.description: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.

items.name: Keratinos
items.description: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.

items.name: Kesheg
items.description: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.

items.name: Kestrel
items.description: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.

items.name: Kestrel Prime
items.description: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.

items.name: Kogake
items.description: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.

items.name: Kogake Prime
items.description: Deliver a golden knockout with these prime Melee Weapons.

items.name: Korrudo
items.description: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.

items.name: Korumm
items.description: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.

items.name: Kreska
items.description: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.

items.name: Krohkur
items.description: This hooked blade rewards critical hits to those skilled enough to strike with finesse.

items.name: Kronen
items.description: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.

items.name: Kronen Prime
items.description: Ancient blades, perfected for today’s combat.

items.name: Kuva Ghoulsaw
items.description: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.

items.name: Kuva Shildeg
items.description: A crushing, killing, rocket-powered stab-hammer. Grineer, naturally.

items.name: Lacera
items.description: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.

items.name: Lecta
items.description: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.

items.name: Lesion
items.description: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.

items.name: Machete
items.description: A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.

items.name: Machete Wraith
items.description: A different take on a familiar combat knife, the Machete Wraith features unique styling.

items.name: Magistar
items.description: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.

items.name: Masseter
items.description: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.

items.name: Masseter Prime
items.description: A greatsword for those with an insatiable hunger for victory. Grendel is immune to crowd-control when he performs Heavy Attacks with this weapon.

items.name: Mios
items.description: This bone-forged sword includes a tendon-whip to distract and maim the enemy.

items.name: Mire
items.description: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage on Ground Slam attacks.

items.name: Mk1-Bo
items.description: The MK1-Bo is the standard issue staff weapon for all Tenno.

items.name: Mk1-Furax
items.description: The MK1-Furax is the standard issue fist weapon for all Tenno.

items.name: Nami Skyla
items.description: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.

items.name: Nami Skyla Prime
items.description: Forged by a forgotten master, these exquisite blades are bounty from a golden-age long gone.

items.name: Nami Solo
items.description: Evoking the oceans of earth, this exquisite cutlass is a deadly work of art.

items.name: Nepheri
items.description: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.

items.name: Nikana
items.description: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.

items.name: Nikana Prime
items.description: An ancient blade predating the fall of the Orokin Empire. Forged using techniques lost over the centuries, the edge remains sharper than that of any modern Nikana.

items.name: Ninkondi
items.description: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.

items.name: Ninkondi Prime
items.description: An ancient weapon imbued with a new truth.

items.name: Obex
items.description: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.

items.name: Ohma
items.description: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.

items.name: Okina
items.description: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.

items.name: Okina Prime
items.description: Enforce authority with these fine-edged sai blades.

items.name: Orthos
items.description: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.

items.name: Orthos Prime
items.description: Orthos Prime is an ancient Orokin martial weapon, forged from the purest Rubedo making it extremely light-weight.

items.name: Orvius
items.description: Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.

items.name: Pangolin Prime
items.description: A classic Tenno blade, beautifully reimagined.

items.name: Pangolin Sword
items.description: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.

items.name: Paracesis
items.description: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.

items.name: Pathocyst
items.description: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with the enemy.

items.name: Pennant
items.description: The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.

items.name: Plasma Sword
items.description: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

items.name: Praedos
items.description: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.

items.name: Pride
items.description: The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.

items.name: Prisma Dual Cleavers
items.description: Blades of energized prisma crystal make these ornamental cleavers cut as sharply as they look.

items.name: Prisma Machete
items.description: The addition of Prisma Crystal allows this otherwise barbaric weapon to elegantly hack through any foe.

items.name: Prisma Obex
items.description: Dazzle, distract and destroy with these sparring weapons of impossibly hard prisma crystal.

items.name: Prisma Ohma
items.description: Prisma crystals glisten in these electrified tonfas.

items.name: Prisma Skana
items.description: Forged from raw prisma crystals and infused with Void energy, this blade's pristine edge is honed razor-sharp to eviscerate even the most deadly of foes.

items.name: Prova
items.description: The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.

items.name: Prova Vandal
items.description: A customized version of the vicious Prova, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

items.name: Pulmonars
items.description: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.

items.name: Pupacyst
items.description: A two-pronged attack; the bone-grafted cocoon at the tip of this polearm rends flesh, while the viral mass living within spreads itself into the wounds of each new victim.

items.name: Quassus
items.description: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.

items.name: Quassus Prime
items.description: Wield Xaku Prime’s elegant fan, its gilded edges crafted for both precision and prestige.

items.name: Rakta Dark Dagger
items.description: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.

items.name: Reaper Prime
items.description: Reaper Prime is an ornamental scythe, with a blade forged from tempered Rubedo.

items.name: Redeemer
items.description: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.

items.name: Redeemer Prime
items.description: Deal double-bladed, double-barreled death with this primed gunblade.

items.name: Ripkas
items.description: Motorized saw claw weapon.

items.name: Rumblejack
items.description: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.

items.name: Ruvox
items.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.

items.name: Sampotes
items.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

items.name: Sancti Magistar
items.description: Each charged attack turns the enemy’s pain into a healing pulse that washes over allies. Also, creates resistance to Status Effects when held.

items.name: Sarofang
items.description: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.

items.name: Sarofang Prime
items.description: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.

items.name: Sarpa
items.description: Makes sweeping cuts punctuated by bursts of heavy gunfire.

items.name: Scindo
items.description: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.

items.name: Scindo Prime
items.description: An ancient executioners weapon, the honor of decapitation by the Scindo Prime was reserved for the Orokin's most respected enemies.

items.name: Scoliac
items.description: The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage with attacks.

items.name: Secura Lecta
items.description: Whip the enemy out of their ill-gotten gains; double credit drops on kills.

items.name: Serro
items.description: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.

items.name: Shaku
items.description: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.

items.name: Sheev
items.description: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.

items.name: Sibear
items.description: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.

items.name: Sigma & Octantis
items.description: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.

items.name: Silva & Aegis
items.description: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.

items.name: Silva & Aegis Prime
items.description: A perfectly crafted pairing, this mace and shield combination is sculpted for exhibition but balanced for the battlefield.

items.name: Skana
items.description: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.

items.name: Skana Prime
items.description: A basic blade known as a Skana. It is widely used by the Tenno. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

items.name: Skiajati
items.description: Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.

items.name: Slaytra
items.description: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects.

items.name: Spinnerex
items.description: Each lash of Oraxia's whip injects its victim with a dose of deadly toxin. Upon death, afflicted enemies have a chance to burst, damaging nearby enemies and spreading the poison.

items.name: Stropha
items.description: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.

items.name: Sun & Moon
items.description: Teshin's twin blades.

items.name: Syam
items.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

items.name: Sydon
items.description: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.

items.name: Synoid Heliocor
items.description: This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.

items.name: Tak & Lug
items.description: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.

items.name: Tatsu
items.description: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.

items.name: Tatsu Prime
items.description: Tatsu Prime glows with spectral splendor. It grows more powerful with each enemy’s demise, especially when wielded by Revenant.

items.name: Tekko
items.description: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.

items.name: Tekko Prime
items.description: As merciless and indestructible as Atlas Prime himself, Tekko Prime crush and split with tectonic force.

items.name: Telos Boltace
items.description: Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way.

items.name: Tenet Agendus
items.description: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.

items.name: Tenet Exec
items.description: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.

items.name: Tenet Grigori
items.description: On Heavy Slide Attack, this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

items.name: Tenet Livia
items.description: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

items.name: Thalys
items.description: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.

items.name: Tipedo
items.description: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.

items.name: Tipedo Prime
items.description: With their final breath they look to the moon, and are gone.

items.name: Tonbo
items.description: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.

items.name: Tonkkatt
items.description: Rend enemies and up the heat with these mining tools repurposed into machine-tonfa. Building the Combo Multiplier overheats the Tonkkatts, setting enemies ablaze.

items.name: Twin Basolk
items.description: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.

items.name: Twin Krohkur
items.description: Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.

items.name: Vastilok
items.description: Slash and blast with this heavy Gunblade of brutal Grineer design. High slash damage paired with a heavy shotgun attack.

items.name: Vaykor Sydon
items.description: Justice blinds. Block hits to charge a Radial Blind, when fully charged Block+Heavy Attack to unleash it.

items.name: Venato
items.description: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.

items.name: Venato Prime
items.description: Fashioned from the willingly donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against 'common enemies' of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from the darkness beyond Tau.

items.name: Venka
items.description: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.

items.name: Venka Prime
items.description: Gleaming blades of white draw blood of the deepest red.

items.name: Verdilac
items.description: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.

items.name: Vericres
items.description: Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.

items.name: Vitrica
items.description: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.

items.name: Volnus
items.description: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.

items.name: Volnus Prime
items.description: The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.

items.name: War
items.description: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.

items.name: War Prime
items.description: The blade of the world-destroyer reaches its apotheosis, severing conflict itself. In forging this weapon, you have brought unrealized dreams to their ultimate conclusion.

items.name: Wolf Sledge
items.description: The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.

items.name: Wrath
items.description: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.

items.name: Xoris
items.description: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.

items.name: Zenistar
items.description: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.
